nodes.title: Baseline — no materials
nodes.description: Reference acoustic + performance capture of the drone-paczek rig with no covering/lining material applied. Establishes the dB floor every material treatment is compared against.

nodes.title: EPP foam
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with EPP (expanded polypropylene) foam. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Thinsulate
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with 3M Thinsulate acoustic insulation. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Cardboard
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with cardboard. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: XPS foam
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with XPS (extruded polystyrene) foam. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Evaluate — July material set
nodes.description: Rank EPP / Thinsulate / cardboard / XPS against the 2026-07-24 baseline. Note the whole set shares one continuous 14.2 s ramp, so recirculation bias is common-mode across materials but not across PWM steps.

nodes.title: Baseline — no materials (2026-08-28)
nodes.description: Fresh no-material reference captured 2026-08-28 on the rebuilt rig (11 UMIK-2 mics, Tyto on the Pi, 2S pack). Independent root reference for this session's felt / rubber / felt+rubber / cork treatments — not a continuation of the 2026-07-24 baseline.

nodes.title: Felt
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with felt. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Rubber
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with rubber. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 1 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: First no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. The 2026-08-31 13:46 capture was scrapped; awaiting a re-run. Independent root: horizontal-plane levels are not comparable with the vertical elevation arc.

nodes.title: Rubber — horizontal measurement
nodes.description: Rubber lining measured in the horizontal plane, rather than the standard vertical elevation arc. Compared against the 2026-08-28 baseline and against the vertical-arc rubber run.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 2 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: Second no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. Paired with horizontal 1 to bound rig drift across the session — material results only mean something to the extent the two baselines agree.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 3 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: Third no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. Repeat baselines bound rig drift across the session — the spread between them sets the floor below which a material difference is not meaningful.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 4 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: Fourth no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. Repeat baselines bound rig drift across the session — the spread between them sets the floor below which a material difference is not meaningful.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 5 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: Fifth no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. Repeat baselines bound rig drift across the session — the spread between them sets the floor below which a material difference is not meaningful.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal 6 (2026-08-31)
nodes.description: Sixth no-material reference for the horizontal-plane measurements. Repeat baselines bound rig drift across the session — the spread between them sets the floor below which a material difference is not meaningful.
nodes.notes: Two ramps in this key (14:31:53 and 14:32:24). Results merges same-PWM captures, so pick one before comparing.

nodes.title: Felt + rubber
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with a combined felt and rubber treatment — felt for absorption over rubber for mass/damping. Measured as its own treatment alongside the single materials, against the 2026-08-28 baseline.

nodes.title: Cork
nodes.description: Drone-paczek rig lined with cork. Compared against the no-material baseline.

nodes.title: Evaluate — 2026-08-28 material set
nodes.description: Rank felt / rubber / felt+rubber / cork against the 2026-08-28 baseline.

nodes.title: Ranked linings, both sessions
nodes.description: Combined ranking across both sessions. Each material must be normalised against ITS OWN session baseline before comparison — the two sessions used different rig states (mic count, stand host, battery), so absolute levels are not comparable across them.

nodes.title: Chosen lining for the parcel drone
nodes.description: Pick the lining to carry forward, trading noise reduction against added mass — a parcel drone pays for damping in payload.

nodes.title: Propeller sweep — horizontal
nodes.description: Rig node for the horizontal-plane propeller comparison. Each propeller gets its own no-material baseline; propellers are only comparable against each other, not against the fixed-propeller baselines 1-6.

nodes.title: Baseline — horizontal, propeller 1
nodes.description: No-material horizontal-plane reference for propeller 1. Any material measured with propeller 1 must be compared against this baseline, not against another propeller's.
